name.description: Trimmed, non-empty display metadata; never interpreted as CSS or a path.

family.description: Trimmed, non-empty display metadata; never interpreted as CSS or a path.

fonts.description: Exact project faces with unique IDs. References and descriptor bytes are validated separately.

linearTransform.description: [a,b,c,d] linear affine matrix; x/y are the sole translation. Exclusive with rotation. Parser checks singular values and condition number against capabilities.geometry.limits; reflections are supported.

fills.description: Top paint first; IDs must be unique within the list (checked by the document parser). Frame surfaces only.

imageToFrame.description: UV unit rectangle to frame-local CSS pixels [a,b,c,d,e,f]. Parser checks invertibility and affine limits.

stops.description: Offsets must be nondecreasing (checked by the document parser).

lineHeight.description: Explicit CSS pixels, not a unitless multiplier.
